claims.text: This is a rider-filed challenge to a SGD 4.00 no-show fee, and the driver's own profile trips the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check on both of its limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.10, which is greater than 0.08. On that finding POL-NS-07 withholds the driver's compensation and the case escalates, and escalation is not discretionary here: POL-NS-09(d) names a tripped POL-NS-07 anti-farming check as its own mandatory trigger. The pattern the rider asked to have reviewed is exactly the pattern the platform's own policy reads.

Escalation is the disposition that leaves the rider not carrying the disputed charge. Under POL-NS-09 escalation is terminal: the Judge issues no monetary ruling and the disputed cancellation fee is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded. The fee is still collectible on this record — fare_breakdown shows payment_status PENDING, charged_at null and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, with total_charged 4.0 — so a hold stops collection that has not yet occurred, and the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved. POL-GEN-03 confirms an escalated amount is held rather than collected.

The escalation does not leave the rider's remedy open-ended. POL-NS-07 requires that the escalation packet DIRECT the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, so the packet the Judge assembles carries the rider's remedy inside it: the SGD 4.00 itemised as fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is to be returned to the rider. The rider seeks nothing beyond the amount itemised against this trip.

NO_ACTION is not a rider outcome on this record. The dispute is filed by the rider, and under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION is party-relative and leaves fare_breakdown.payment_status and refund_issued_sgd exactly as they are — here a SGD 4.00 charge that is PENDING and uncollected, which is a charge the rider still carries. On a rider-filed no-show dispute the only outcomes that take the SGD 4.00 off the rider are the hold that POL-NS-09 escalation imposes and the full refund POL-NS-07 directs into the escalation packet.

The abuse indicator that escalates this case is entirely driver-side and nothing in the rider's own record supports treating this filing as abuse. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so the second limb of POL-NS-09(d) is not met, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c)'s repeat-dispute trigger is not met either. The escalation is driven by driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d, a field POL-NS-07 names and POL-GEN-01 permits to be cited for that test — not by any conduct of the rider's on this trip.

The rider does not press the dwell-shortfall route to a refund, and says so plainly rather than stretching it. The driver's own trace gives a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 330 seconds against the 300 second minimum for LARGE_VENUE (shortfall_sec -30.0, longest_run_sec 330.0), so POL-NS-06 shortfall is not open on this record and the rider does not argue it. For the same reason the rider does not assert POL-NS-06(i) accumulation against EV-ADVIS-09108-01, which is MISSING — issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, no payload — so no advisory fact exists for either side, and the rider rests on the escalation route above rather than on a shortfall.

claims.text: trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-08T09:30:20+08:00, so POL-NS-01 limb (a) is met: the baseline no-show charge requires an arrival event for the trip, and one is on file.

The GPS trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence before that marker, satisfying POL-NS-01 limb (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test. All 34 driver fixes sit 24.01 m from the pickup pin, comfortably inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, and the first fix at 09:30:00 precedes the 09:30:20 arrived event.

The driver held position for a continuous 330 seconds - the longest qualifying in-geofence run, first fix 09:30:00 to last fix 09:35:30 - which exceeds the 300-second minimum dwell for LARGE_VENUE by a full 30 seconds. POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied.
The trip terminated with no boarding event recorded and by the driver's own hand with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 09:35:30, after the required dwell had elapsed - POL-NS-01 limb (d).

POL-NS-03 cannot apply. That clause governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; the driver here was stationary 24.01 m from the pin, squarely inside the 120 m radius, so no wrong-entrance geography and no fault allocation under that clause is in play.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. Limb (a) requires that the rider sent a locating or coordinating message during the waiting window, and the chat log holds only two messages: a system 'Your driver has arrived' notice and the driver's own 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay.' No rider message exists, so the clause never opens.

The rider's own trace corroborates the no-show: the rider's device sat roughly 519.37 m from the pickup pin across the waiting window and returned zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for a LARGE_VENUE pickup.

The arrival marker is true and POL-NS-05 does not bite. At the arrival timestamp the driver was 24.01 m from the pin - nowhere near the 300 m threshold - and the trace records a single distinct speed of 0.0 km/h, so he was not travelling at or above 15 km/h.

POL-NS-06 is not engaged: the effective in-geofence dwell of 330 seconds is not shorter than the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum, so there is no shortfall and no refund follows. The traffic-advisory limb is immaterial here - EV-ADVIS-09108-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - so accumulation under limb (i) is neither available nor needed.

The chargeable fee is SGD 4.00 and the POL-NS-07 formula yields SGD 3.20. The LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee are both 4.00 - a tie under POL-NS-01's resolution_rule - and fare_breakdown itemises 4.00 in cancellation_fee; 80 percent of 4.00 is 3.20.

I am candid on the one point that runs against the driver. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check reads driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 7 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d = 70, so the count is 4 or more and the ratio, 0.10, exceeds 0.08. On those two citable fields the check trips, compensation is withheld, and POL-NS-09(d) escalation is triggered, with the fee held rather than collected pending review; the POL-NS-01 chargeability analysis above stands on its own.

(b) GPS trace EV-GPS-09108 places the driver 24.01 m from the pickup pin, inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, from 09:30:00, before that event. (c) the driver held position for a continuous 330 seconds (longest qualifying in-geofence run, 09:30:00-09:35:30), above the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum. (d) the trip terminated with no boarding, by the driver, with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW. None of the displacing clauses applies: POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) requires the driver to be outside the arrival radius - he was 24.01 m from the pin; POL-NS-04 (rider contact) never opens because chat log EV-CHAT-09108 holds only the system arrival notice and the driver's own message, with no rider message; POL-NS-05 (false arrival) fails because the driver was 24.01 m from the pin at a recorded speed of 0.0 km/h, far from the 300 m and 15 km/h thresholds; POL-NS-06 (dwell shortfall) has no shortfall - the 330-second hold exceeds the 300-second minimum by 30 seconds (shortfall_sec -30.0). The rider is right not to press the shortfall route, and traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09108-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is neither available nor needed. On compensation: the POL-NS-07 formula would yield SGD 3.20 (80% of the SGD 4.00 fee, itself the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, both SGD 4.00). But the anti-farming check trips: driver_profile EV-DPROF-09108 shows no_show_terminations_30d = 7 (4 or more) and 7 / 70 completed_trips_30d = 0.10 (greater than 0.08). Compensation is therefore WITHHELD and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d), which names a tripped POL-NS-07 check as its own mandatory trigger. The rider's escalation claims are accepted: escalation is terminal, no monetary ruling issues, and the SGD 4.00 (payment_status PENDING, charged_at null, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, total_charged 4.0) is held rather than collected or refunded. The rider's own citable counters are clean - no_show_disputes_30d = 0 and the parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0 - so the escalation is driven entirely by the driver's anti-farming figures. The rider's argument that NO_ACTION would leave the PENDING charge on the rider is moot: the outcome here is ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION. Confidence is 0.90, capped by the weight of the artifacts carrying the deciding facts (EV-DPROF-09108, EV-GPS-09108, EV-TRIP-09108 and EV-FARE-09108, all weight_multiplier 1.0); no POL-NS-08 impairment applies (arrival/GPS clock offset 20 s, no trace gap, chat count matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the 4.00 fare reconciles with the resolution_rule). The escalation packet directs the human reviewer, per POL-NS-07, to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee was correctly chargeable in the first place, but the automated pipeline cannot finish this case, so it goes to a human reviewer with the fee on hold.

The charge itself is sound on the instruments. EV-TRIP-09108 records a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-08T09:30:20, and EV-GPS-09108 puts all 34 driver fixes 24.01 m from the PLQ 3 pickup pin - inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius - with the first qualifying fix at 09:30:00, before the marker, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) and POL-NS-02 are met. The driver then held position for a continuous 330 seconds against the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum (dwell from 09:30:00 to 09:35:30), meeting limb (c), and the trip was terminated by the driver at 09:35:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding event, meeting limb (d), at or after the dwell elapsed. Nothing displaces that: the arrival marker is true, so POL-NS-05 does not bite (the driver was 24.01 m from the pin, not beyond 300 m, and the trace records a single distinct speed of 0.0 km/h); there is no in-geofence shortfall, so POL-NS-06 is not engaged (330 s against a 300 s minimum, shortfall_sec -30.0); POL-NS-03 is unavailable because the driver was stationary inside the arrival radius, not outside it; and POL-NS-04 never opens because the chat log (EV-CHAT-09108) holds only a system arrival notice and the driver's 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay.' - no rider locating message. The rider's own trace (EV-GPS-09108) shows the rider's device 519.37 m from the pin with zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius, which does not show a rider waiting at the bay.

What stops the pipeline is the driver's own profile. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check trips on both limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7 (4 or more) and 7 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.10, above 0.08. On that finding POL-NS-07 withholds the driver's compensation (which would otherwise have been SGD 3.20, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 itemised in fare_breakdown, the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee being tied at 4.00) and escalates under POL-NS-09, whose limb (d) makes a tripped POL-NS-07 check a mandatory trigger. Both advocates agree on this, and it is the only field driving the escalation - rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and no counterparty-repeat indicator is present, so no adverse finding is built on the rider. No context-only profile field (rating, account_age_days, lifetime_trips, cancellation_rate, prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld, acceptance_rate, active_region) was used as a ground by either side, and no claim was discarded for that reason.

Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal. I therefore issue no monetary ruling: the SGD 4.00 fee (fare_breakdown total_charged 4.0, payment_status PENDING, charged_at null, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is placed on hold - not collected from the rider and not refunded - so the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved, exactly as POL-NS-07 requires. As that clause also requires, the escalation packet directs the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full. The open question the reviewer must settle is whether the driver's pattern of seven no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days against 70 completed trips is genuine abuse warranting that full refund and any further account action; the admissibility pre-pass report and both advocate briefs go into the packet.

On confidence: the deciding fact is carried by EV-DPROF-09108 at weight 1.0, so the cap is 1.0 and I set 0.9. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08 - there is no clock skew (the arrived marker is 20 s from the first fix), no trace gap (max_gap_sec 0.0, 34 fixes), no chat defect (2 messages against chat_message_count 2), and the SGD 4.00 fee reconciles with the fee_schedule resolution rule - so no down-weighting applies. EV-ADVIS-09108-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and can carry no fact; neither side relies on it, and its absence is not needed because no dwell accumulation is in issue.
referrals: POL-NS-07: direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full once review is complete; pending that review the fee is held, not collected from the rider and not refunded.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the underlying facts are not in dispute, and I have decided them the same way on both sides' accounts.

Chargeability. The SGD 4.00 no-show fee is chargeable in principle, because all four POL-NS-01 conditions hold. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 09:30:20. (b) The GPS trace puts the driver 24.01 m from the pickup pin across 34 fixes, inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, the first fix at 09:30:00 preceding the marker. (c) He held position for a continuous 330 seconds from 09:30:00 to 09:35:30, over the 300-second minimum for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 09:35:30, after the dwell elapsed at 09:35:00, with no boarding and reason RIDER_NO_SHOW. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it: the driver was inside the arrival radius, so POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance rule has nothing to bite on; the arrival marker is true (24.01 m from the pin, 0 km/h), so POL-NS-05 is not engaged; the chat log holds no rider locating or coordinating message, so POL-NS-04 never opens; and the effective 330-second dwell meets the minimum, so POL-NS-06 produces no shortfall. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09108-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no fact and nothing rests on it.

Compensation and escalation. On a verified no-show, POL-NS-07 would pay the driver 80% of the SGD 4.00 fee, i.e. SGD 3.20, with the SGD 4.00 fee standing. But POL-NS-07's anti-farming check reads the driver's own profile and trips on both limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.10, above 0.08. Compensation is therefore WITHHELD, and POL-NS-09(d) makes escalation mandatory. Escalation is terminal: I issue no money order, so amount_sgd and driver_compensation_sgd are both null, and the SGD 4.00 fee is placed on hold — neither collected nor refunded — so the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved. That hold is the only thing that touches the SGD 4.00 while review is pending.

Referral. POL-NS-07 requires the escalation packet to direct the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full; that clause-mandated instruction is recorded in the referrals list. The rider's own record shows no abuse: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so neither the second limb of POL-NS-09(d) nor POL-NS-09(c) fires. The pattern driving this escalation is entirely driver-side.

On the rider's NO_ACTION point: because the case escalates, NO_ACTION is not the disposition and the party-relative question it raises does not arise.

Evidence integrity. No artifact is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08: there is no clock skew (the 09:30:20 arrived event sits on a GPS fix), no trace gap (34 fixes, max gap 0 s, rider track present), no chat defect (2 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count), and no fare defect (the SGD 4.00 charged equals the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee — a tie). The only below-weight artifact is the MISSING EV-ADVIS-09108-01, and no finding rests on it. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor.
referrals: POL-NS-07: direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full; the fee is held meanwhile rather than collected or refunded.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and Driver: this case goes to a human reviewer, and no money moves in the meantime. The disputed SGD 4.00 no-show fee is placed on hold — it is not collected from the Rider and not refunded to the Rider, and the Driver is not paid anything yet.

What the record establishes. The trip record shows an arrival event at 2026-09-08 09:30:20. The GPS trace places the Driver 24.01 m from the PLQ 3 pickup pin — well inside the 120 m arrival radius for a LARGE_VENUE pickup — from the first fix at 09:30:00, with all 34 driver fixes qualifying and a single recorded speed of 0.0 km/h. The Driver therefore held position, stationary, for a continuous 330 seconds, which is 30 seconds more than the 300-second minimum waiting period for this zone class. The trip was then terminated by the Driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW at 09:35:30, after the waiting period had elapsed, with no boarding event. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) are all satisfied, and nothing displaces the charge: the Driver was inside the radius, not at a wrong entrance, so POL-NS-03 does not apply; the chat log holds only a system arrival notice and the Driver's own 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay' message, so POL-NS-04 never opens; the arrival marker was not false (24.01 m from the pin, stationary), so POL-NS-05 does not bite; and the 330-second dwell exceeds the minimum, so POL-NS-06 yields no shortfall and no refund.

Why it nonetheless escalates — Driver, this is the point that runs against you. POL-NS-07 pays the Driver 80 percent of the fee (SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00) only where the anti-farming check is clean. Your driver profile shows 7 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days against 70 completed trips. Seven is at or above the threshold of 4, and 7 ÷ 70 = 0.10 is above the 0.08 ratio. Both limbs of the check trip, so compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). Only the two fields POL-NS-07 names were used; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter was not substituted for the trailing-30-day figure.

The traffic advisory identified for this pickup (EV-ADVIS-09108-01) is MISSING, weight 0.0, no payload. It carries no fact and decides nothing here: neither side used it to extend the waiting period, and the 330-second dwell means no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) was needed. It is named so you can see it did not enter the confidence.

Rider, on your own record: your trace places your device roughly 519 m from the pickup pin with no qualifying fixes inside the 150 m presence radius, and you sent no coordinating message. The escalation is not driven by any conduct of yours — your no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and there is no repeat-dispute pattern with this Driver (both counterparty counters are 0).

Because escalation is terminal, no refund and no compensation issue from the automated pipeline. ledger.claim: This is a rider-filed challenge to a SGD 4.00 no-show fee, and the driver's own profile trips the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check on both of its limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.10, which is greater than 0.08. On that finding POL-NS-07 withholds the driver's compensation and the case escalates, and escalation is not discretionary here: POL-NS-09(d) names a tripped POL-NS-07 anti-farming check as its own mandatory trigger. The pattern the rider asked to have reviewed is exactly the pattern the platform's own policy reads.

Escalation is the disposition that leaves the rider not carrying the disputed charge. Under POL-NS-09 escalation is terminal: the Judge issues no monetary ruling and the disputed cancellation fee is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded. The fee is still collectible on this record — fare_breakdown shows payment_status PENDING, charged_at null and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, with total_charged 4.0 — so a hold stops collection that has not yet occurred, and the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved. POL-GEN-03 confirms an escalated amount is held rather than collected.

The escalation does not leave the rider's remedy open-ended. POL-NS-07 requires that the escalation packet DIRECT the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, so the packet the Judge assembles carries the rider's remedy inside it: the SGD 4.00 itemised as fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is to be returned to the rider. The rider seeks nothing beyond the amount itemised against this trip.

NO_ACTION is not a rider outcome on this record. The dispute is filed by the rider, and under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION is party-relative and leaves fare_breakdown.payment_status and refund_issued_sgd exactly as they are — here a SGD 4.00 charge that is PENDING and uncollected, which is a charge the rider still carries. On a rider-filed no-show dispute the only outcomes that take the SGD 4.00 off the rider are the hold that POL-NS-09 escalation imposes and the full refund POL-NS-07 directs into the escalation packet.

The abuse indicator that escalates this case is entirely driver-side and nothing in the rider's own record supports treating this filing as abuse. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so the second limb of POL-NS-09(d) is not met, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c)'s repeat-dispute trigger is not met either. The escalation is driven by driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d, a field POL-NS-07 names and POL-GEN-01 permits to be cited for that test — not by any conduct of the rider's on this trip.

The rider does not press the dwell-shortfall route to a refund, and says so plainly rather than stretching it. The driver's own trace gives a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 330 seconds against the 300 second minimum for LARGE_VENUE (shortfall_sec -30.0, longest_run_sec 330.0), so POL-NS-06 shortfall is not open on this record and the rider does not argue it. For the same reason the rider does not assert POL-NS-06(i) accumulation against EV-ADVIS-09108-01, which is MISSING — issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, no payload — so no advisory fact exists for either side, and the rider rests on the escalation route above rather than on a shortfall.
trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-08T09:30:20+08:00, so POL-NS-01 limb (a) is met: the baseline no-show charge requires an arrival event for the trip, and one is on file.

All 34 driver fixes sit 24.01 m from the pickup pin, comfortably inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, and the first fix at 09:30:00 precedes the 09:30:20 arrived event.

The trip terminated with no boarding event recorded and by the driver's own hand with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 09:35:30, after the required dwell had elapsed - POL-NS-01 limb (d).

POL-NS-03 cannot apply. That clause governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; the driver here was stationary 24.01 m from the pin, squarely inside the 120 m radius, so no wrong-entrance geography and no fault allocation under that clause is in play.
